lines.zh: 缓慢地移动着沉重的身体。
lines.en: Moves slowly, its body heavy.

lines.zh: 用尾巴敲击地面，发出低沉的声音。
lines.en: Bangs its tail on the ground, making a low sound.

lines.zh: 发出咕噜声，好像在消化食物。
lines.en: Makes a rumbling sound, digesting food.

lines.zh: 转动沉重的头颅，寻找食物。
lines.en: Turns its heavy head, searching for food.

lines.zh: 用厚重的鳞片保护自己。
lines.en: Uses its thick scales for protection.
Chews on fresh grass.
Cautiously looks around.

lines.zh: 用尾锤击打地面，发出响声。
lines.en: Bangs its tail on the ground, making a noise.
Goes slowly across the grass.
Rumbles, relaxing its body.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，骨甲刮过草根。
lines.en: I walk low, my bone plates scraping the grass roots.

lines.zh: 四蹄分得很开，步子稳当。
lines.en: My four feet spread wide, each step steady.

lines.zh: 我把尾锤甩到身后护着。
lines.en: I swing my tail club back to guard it.

lines.zh: 肋骨下咯吱响，我慢慢挪。
lines.en: My ribs creak as I shift along slowly.

lines.zh: 沿着窝边绕一圈，再往前走。
lines.en: I circle the nest once, then move on.

lines.zh: 我低头啃一口草，又抬头看。
lines.en: I take a bite of grass, then look up again.
Stands quietly, waiting.
Rub its hard horns on the ground.

lines.zh: 偶尔转动头部，寻找目标。
lines.en: Occasionally turns its head, searching.

lines.zh: 用尾巴拍打身体，清理身上的泥土。
lines.en: Pats its body with its tail, clearing dirt.
Bends down to chew grass.
Rests quietly, enjoying peace.
Occasionally swats its tail around.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的呼噜声，享受安宁。
lines.en: Makes a low rumble, enjoying peace.

lines.zh: 平静地站立，观察着环境。
lines.en: Stands calmly, observing the surroundings.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的鳞片轻轻摩擦。
lines.en: Rub its hard scales gently.

lines.zh: 把下巴搁在地上歇一歇。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the ground for a while.
The sun has made my back plates hot.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨了一下厚眼皮。
lines.en: I blink my heavy eyelids once, slowly.
I turn sideways to let the wind through my plates.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，转动沉重的头。
lines.en: Notices the player, turning its heavy head.

lines.zh: 用锋利的眼睛盯着玩家。
lines.en: Glares at the player with sharp eyes.

lines.zh: 警惕地盯着玩家的动作。
lines.en: Cautiously watches the player's movements.

lines.zh: 缓缓地转动脖子，观察玩家。
lines.en: Turns its neck slowly, observing the player.

lines.zh: 用厚重的鳞片保护自己
lines.en: Uses its thick scales for protection — 甲龙, look player

lines.zh: 用尾锤警惕地敲击地面。
lines.en: Bangs its tail on the ground, alertly.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的低鸣，是最后一次警告。
lines.en: The rumble in my throat is the last warning.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的角磨擦地面，警惕。
lines.en: Rub its hard horns on the ground, alert.

lines.zh: 转动沉重的头颅，寻找玩家。
lines.en: Turns its heavy head, searching for the player.

lines.zh: 用尾巴轻扫玩家，发出警告。
lines.en: Swats the player with its tail, warning.

lines.zh: 你身上没有草味，我不放心。
lines.en: You don't smell of grass. I don't trust that.
I look up and my tail club halts mid-swing.

lines.zh: 你越走越近，我鼻子喷气。
lines.en: As you come closer, I snort.
I tilt my head and listen to your steps.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我往后挪了半步。
lines.en: You reach out, and I shuffle half a step back.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的手，不看你的脸。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your face.

lines.zh: 甲龙的皮甲碎了，露出里面的伤痕！
lines.en: The armor of the ankylosaurus cracked, revealing the injury inside!

lines.zh: 我的骨头疼，快帮我治疗！
lines.en: My bones hurt, help me heal!

lines.zh: 身体受伤了，需要慢慢恢复！
lines.en: My body is injured, needs time to recover!
My scales are cracked, they hurt!
Tail club injured, can't move!
Hit by a rock, it hurts!
Leaves scratched me, it hurts!
Scratched by bushes, it hurts!
Scratched by thorns, it hurts!
My armor is shattered, it hurts!

lines.zh: 吼吼！那块肉闻起来真香！
lines.en: Rumble! That meat smells good!
My bony armor protects me!

lines.zh: 你离我远点！我是素食的！
lines.en: Stay away! I’m herbivore!
Watch my tail club!
My skull is hard, don’t touch!
Feel my retaliation!
I’ll eat some grass!
This land is mine, go away!

lines.zh: 我的骨甲可以防住攻击！
lines.en: My armor can block attacks!
Don't wave grass near my territory.
Try hitting me!

lines.zh: 我的尾锤不会轻易放过的！
lines.en: My tail club won’t let go!

lines.zh: 尾巴上的锤，已经抬起来。
lines.en: The tail club is already raised.
My armor is very hard!
Don’t hit me!

lines.zh: 你撞上我的骨甲，疼的是你。
lines.en: You hit my bone armor - the pain is yours.
My retaliation is quick!
Let me see your strength!
My armor can defend!
I’m prepared, be careful!

lines.zh: 求偶季节到了，我要找伴！
lines.en: Mating season, I need a partner!

lines.zh: 尾锤边上，还缺一个同伴。
lines.en: Beside my tail club, a mate is missing.

lines.zh: 尾锤放低了，谁敢靠近我。
lines.en: Tail club lowered — who dares come close?
My armor is for courting!

lines.zh: 求偶的季节到了，我准备好了！
lines.en: Mating season, I’m ready!

lines.zh: 这片河谷够养大我们的幼崽。
lines.en: This river valley can raise our young.
I’m looking for my mate!

lines.zh: 我的骨甲可以吸引伴侣！
lines.en: My armor attracts a mate!

lines.zh: 求偶季节，我准备好交配了！
lines.en: Mating season, I’m ready to mate!

lines.zh: 我需要一个伴侣来延续种族！
lines.en: I need a mate to continue the species!

lines.zh: 吼声震天响，草食我不伤。
lines.en: Roar loud, no herbivore harm.

lines.zh: 我护甲坚硬，你别想靠近。
lines.en: My armor is hard, keep away.
I’m the land’s ruler, back off.
Stay back, my bones shield me.
Intrude, and I’ll retaliate.
My tail breaks armor.
My scales protect me.
Tame me, I can help.
Listen to my growl.
I eat grass, not you.
Targeting you, beware.

lines.zh: 低头的姿势，就是我要冲了。
lines.en: Head lowered - that means I'm charging.
You’re in my sight.
My bone club ready.
Prepare to fight your provocation.
Watch out, here I come.

lines.zh: 你踩断的蕨叶，我记下了。
lines.en: I noted the fern you snapped underfoot.
My tail club is raised.
My anger’s about to burst.
Who stepped into my ground?

lines.zh: 你闯进来了，我记下你了。
lines.en: You stepped in. I have marked you.

lines.zh: 我转过身，尾锤拖在地上。
lines.en: I turn around, tail club dragging.
You crushed my grass underfoot.

lines.zh: 我摆正身子，把你圈进范围。
lines.en: I square up and bring you into my reach.

lines.zh: 尾锤抬起来了，让开一点。
lines.en: My tail club is up; step back a bit.
My bone club targeting you.
I’m on you, don’t move.
Targeted, don’t come closer.
Watch out, I’m targeting you.
Attack coming.
Beware, I’m targeting you.
My tail will attack you.
My bone club will hit you.
My attack’s coming.

lines.zh: 尾锤抡起来，朝着你的膝盖。
lines.en: My tail club swings for your knees.

lines.zh: 我压低前半身，准备顶你。
lines.en: I lower my front and brace to ram you.

lines.zh: 甲缝里的肌肉都绷紧了。
lines.en: Every muscle between my plates has tightened.

lines.zh: 我一步步挪，把退路堵住。
lines.en: I shuffle forward to block your retreat.

lines.zh: 这次我会连草皮一起砸。
lines.en: This time I'll take the turf with you.
Sssss... Crush you!

lines.zh: 尾锤抡圆了，别站在后面！
lines.en: My tail club swings wide - don't stand behind me!
Come on, feel my tail club!
Your bones will crumble!
Get away, don’t provoke me!
My armor is unbreakable!
Move, I’m striking!
Your attack is futile!
My tail swings; the bone armor rattles.
My bone armor is indestructible!
My tail club sweeps, and you fly!
My shoulder armor drives up and flips you over.

lines.zh: 你砍在骨甲上，刃口卷了！
lines.en: You struck my plates, and your blade curled!

lines.zh: 我侧身一撞，你倒在草丛！
lines.en: I hit you side-on and you fall in the grass!
This is Ankylosaurus territory!
I’ve been waiting for you here!
Who dares to invade my territory?
My armor protects me!
Stay away from my nest!
My tail club lands and leaves a crater.

lines.zh: 尾锤落地，土都跳了一下。
lines.en: My tail club lands and the dirt jumps.

lines.zh: 这里是我的家，我的领地！
lines.en: This is my home, my territory!
My power cannot be trespassed!
Tail club strikes the ground — mine.

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂开，我先顶出尾锤。
lines.en: The shell cracks, and my tail club comes out first.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里站起来，抖了抖甲。
lines.en: I stand up from the grass and rattle my plates.

lines.zh: 这片草地，从现在起归我。
lines.en: This grassland belongs to me from now on.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，露出钝牙。
lines.en: I yawn and show my blunt teeth.

lines.zh: 我闻到了泥土和草的味道。
lines.en: I smell soil and grass.

lines.zh: 谁把我的窝踩出脚印了？
lines.en: Who left footprints on my nest?

lines.zh: 我抬头，骨甲上还挂着草屑。
lines.en: I raise my head with grass stuck to my plates.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过去，挡在窝前。
lines.en: I walk slowly and stand before my nest.

lines.zh: 这附近的味道，都很陌生。
lines.en: Everything around here smells unfamiliar.
Even newly hatched, my tail club is heavy.

lines.zh: 火焰烤着我的骨甲，好烫！
lines.en: The fire bakes my bone plates. Too hot!
Dropped in fire, my tail is on fire!

lines.zh: 掉进水里，尾巴沉了下去！
lines.en: Dropped in water, my tail sank!
Explosion injured, it hurts!

lines.zh: 石头打在我骨甲上，弹开了。
lines.en: A stone struck my bone armor and bounced off.
My tail club can't block magic.
No food, weak body!
Lightning hit, it hurts!
Dropped in void, body shattered!
